# Hash-pinned Python dependencies for the CI planner (plan.py / test_plan.py).
#
# The phase 4 round 1 review found an unpinned `pip install pyyaml` over the
# network at CI-plan time. That code path decides what CI builds and
# publishes, so an unpinned install there is a supply-chain risk. A
# compromised or yanked PyPI release would run inside the planner with no
# check. Round 1 removed the dependency and added a narrow hand-written YAML
# reader (`minimal_yaml.py`). Three more review rounds then found blockers
# where that reader differed from real YAML:
#   - a capitalized `False`
#   - YAML boolean aliases
#   - comma-in-quotes splitting
#   - a `#` against a value
#   - bare numeric scalars
#   - duplicate keys
# CHANGELOG.md's phase 4 log has the full history in 8.9 and the original
# findings in 8.4/8.8. In total, four rounds went to the question of how to
# read images.yaml. YAML's implicit scalar grammar is larger than any
# hand-written rejection list can cover.
#
# Phase 4 reversed that decision. It uses the real PyYAML and closes the
# original round 1 finding with a hash pin. `pip install --require-hashes -r
# this-file` refuses any downloaded artifact that does not match one of the
# sha256 hashes below. So a compromised or substituted release cannot run.
# The hashes come from PyPI's JSON API
# (https://pypi.org/pypi/PyYAML/6.0.3/json).
#
# 6.0.3 is PyPI's current stable release (Sept 2025; 6.0.2 is one version
# older), and it is not yanked.
#
# The hashes cover two kinds of file:
#   - the sdist, a fallback in case no wheel matches the runner's Python build
#   - manylinux2014/2_17/2_28 x86_64 wheels for CPython 3.9 through 3.14
# GitHub's `ubuntu-latest` runner is a glibc x86_64 host.
# `actions/setup-python` with `python-version: "3.x"` uses the latest stable
# release when the workflow runs. So the list covers more versions than the
# one in use today.
PyYAML==6.0.3 \
    --hash=sha256:d76623373421df22fb4cf8817020cbb7ef15c725b9d5e45f17e189bfc384190f \
    --hash=sha256:0150219816b6a1fa26fb4699fb7daa9caf09eb1999f3b70fb6e786805e80375a \
    --hash=sha256:9c7708761fccb9397fe64bbc0395abcae8c4bf7b0eac081e12b809bf47700d0b \
    --hash=sha256:b8bb0864c5a28024fac8a632c443c87c5aa6f215c0b126c449ae1a150412f31d \
    --hash=sha256:ba1cc08a7ccde2d2ec775841541641e4548226580ab850948cbfda66a1befcdc \
    --hash=sha256:0f29edc409a6392443abf94b9cf89ce99889a1dd5376d94316ae5145dfedd5d6 \
    --hash=sha256:c458b6d084f9b935061bc36216e8a69a7e293a2f1e68bf956dcd9e6cbcd143f5
